notes.title: Venge 2.1 is OUT - The Final Act 1 Update
notes.content:
Venge 2.1 is out! This update brings a ton of new content, polish, and a brand new minigame, [b]ACT 1 MADNESS.[/b]

If you'd like a quick recap instead of reading, here's a video covering all of this:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oviyhV16Wts

[h2]Act 1 Madness[/h2]
Act 1 Madness is the brand new minigame that features EVERY monster from Act 1, all attacking you, all at once. This minigame is extremely hard and will take a lot of practice to top the leaderboard. It can be unlocked once you beat Act 1!

Essentially, each boss has their own chamber. Inside of each chamber lives the monster and a snippet of their districts. Complete the chamber and collect their artifact to unlock the main gate to escape! However, once you beat a bosses' chamber they'll escape into the hub... which makes solving the other chambers more difficult!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/dfb963c48ed8c8a4cc8687c1156587c76b02072c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/256ed3b3d1a9ce8da06f86e666c2642f16ae346d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/2a9e7fbc4eca40a3b4a18e65819111dc827ba89b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/b69f02879110c6e50fb3b4c6187c5f40254f1fc0.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Real World[/h2]
The real world has been massively improved, including a fancy new intro that sets the tone much better, and some dangerous mold to keep you on edge! Explore the story of what happened to the employees and Rotnic itself...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/dc06c8fba045e89aeb672421c733b98424ee94c0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/27fafe802f3a75c9f46937f92c4cce569a1584fd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/9707cdb3cb7e2e4752762f4f385b96b0cedf7477.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/7e0181398dc3c8b3fd6eaaa1a63a2d955c06336c.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Cartoonist Boss Fight[/h2]
The cartoonist boss fight has been reworked to take way less time, down from about 1 hour to 30 minutes or less. The map is completely new and a lot smaller. There's now 4 entrances into the nest, with the cartoonist blocking each entrance off one by one as you play! This makes the boss fight way more interesting and much more fun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/117ffe526a4c4adcbf1c4f4714838908bb0053be.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/cfc7cb3624c4a88b28e249f4015c4c7bf475bd97.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/7b86d9a25e8b6fc23dea605432794ac902729ca2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Laserette Pacing Update[/h2]
The laserette has seen a minor pacing update, which speeds up the player and allows for a much more fluid and fast experience!

[h2]CEO Puzzle Repacing[/h2]
The "flipped falls and forgotten halls" scene has been cut down and repaced to be more enjoyable for newer players especially. The puzzle has been reworked and is now much faster with a more interesting cutscene!

[h2]New Sticky Notes[/h2]
Every sticky note has been rewritten to be more interesting and about half of them have been cut, making the whole experience way less annoying. The new story is a bit more obvious lore wise too.

[h2]Tons of new secrets have been added[/h2]
That's all I'll say, have fun hunting!

[h2]Real world cartoons![/h2]
Some real world cartoons have been added, which help Rotnic feel more believable and alive! 3 were made by me, 2 by other artists! (Xioanz and ???)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/af807fa81b1008efdf99aabca471dcfb92a11d6a.gif[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
- new settings
- new loading screen
- new death screen
- launch points
- helpsie skippable dialog
- item keybinds
- inventory shortcuts
- improved crosshair
- inspectable filtering
- inspectables pin rework
- inspectables view emails

Plus thousands of bug fixes!

[h2]The Future[/h2]
This makes the end of the 2.0 saga... I'll be taking a short break then I'll start Act 2 development again! I'm expecting itll be out next year! Thank you all so much for your love, support, and patience. Making this game has been such a journey, thank you!

notes.title: Venge 2.0 is (BASICALLY) Done!
notes.content:
Hello all, thank you all so much for your support and patience, I come with exciting news!
Venge 2.0 is basically done! The gameplay is completed, the systems and ui are completed, all thats left is 2 minigames! I'll get into more details here, but if you want to skip the read, here's a video recapping the same information:
[previewyoutube=oGkmUBdHF04;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Efix 2.0[/h1]
Efix has been completely remade and unlike the other bosses, has had new sections added! I heard a lot of feedback from a lot of you that efix was too short, so this should be much better! Thank you all for your feedback, positive and negative, it really helps me and the game out a ton! Here's some screenshots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/c407e59732e6ad874f56598e97425f08d6e54dc9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/6efa64f1cd71c921b5e284f26f26d884435ebf32.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/8bfa056feae65afa3c7b76b1a1ba6a0dd6d3206e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Skelebans 2.0[/h1]
1.0 had skeletons, a boring generic monster with no personality (no offense), they weren't exactly unique. (I'm sure you can list 12 games with skeletons), so 2.0 has replaced them with SKELEBANS! Skelebans are venge-ified rotting corpses. The cool thing about these fellas is their models are randomly generated! There is about 2.4 MILLION combinations at the moment, with more to come! So assuming less than 2.4 million people play, every single skeleban you see will be 100% unique and never seen before, how cool!

Like efix, their 2nd chase has actually been made into a chase and is much more interesting! Here's some screenshots:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/2c9d53804f67e7f7f768cb1b08e3c31204f7fcab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/c8fc3336f0f5966bb783ffa3775a5dd7cf1785ab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/e7f24b3abb19e21662b774b440eb456b64a1ae71.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/4e4e5fbd3196b353c1546982a82d80e018ac9186.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/ba5b53df401bf63d559957d03839fc0df2e9dc45.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/c9a0018f4681d486ba7025670f9b6e7d63f9fb7c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Minigames![/h1]
Minigames are a very forgettable part of 1.0, but I'm hoping 2.0 will change that! 2.0 Minigames focus on challenge, highscores and leaderboards, and difficulty! Each one has unique gameplay and they are a ton of fun! There are 7 in total:
BONUS - DONE
Endless Bike Ride - DONE
Cartoonist Maze - STARTED
Hide and Seek - DONE
Helpsie's Duel - DONE
Skelebal Scare - DONE
Act 1 madness - NOT DONE

The video has more details and gameplay snippets, but my fingers hurt so you'll have to get the info there! Basically they are done and its great! Here's some screenshots:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/e4e0678d2ed24dc26f2946172a0310855b36c2e2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37215459/a5ad3903ed63629ea97bd90fc72dfc0e9525f224.png[/img]

[h1]Other Information[/h1]
Artifacts have been added, they are basically collectables on steroids. They can be items, inspectables, or even collectables themselves. You find them throughout your adventure and they are saved outside of the universes and will be a ton of fun to find and explore them all! Plus, some of them can even change your gameplay (like skins) and many give important lore clues to those who are interested!

Controller support is coming to 2.0, no longer will you have to make a janky mapping, itll be supported in house!

Commands are getting a lot better with functions, I'll be hopefully adding better scripting support, which basically means "modding" support. It's not a huge focus for 2.0, but it will be there for those who like to play around.

[h1]Release Date[/h1]
I'm 95% confident on my release date, but it could change. Should I tell you... yea I just ya. I'm aiming for [b]AUGUST 16th, 2024[/b]! Venge's 4th anniversary!

The 2.0 update will be COMPLETELY free to anyone who already owns venge, thank you all so much for your support, especially if you have been here since the beginning, it really means a lot to me!
Yall are amazing, see you soon!

Hello everyone, sorry again for the radio silence (I swear all of my posts start this way, I'm so sorry!) but I've got some REALLY exciting news for you all!

Lets start with something you all can play, the public demo! I released a public demo for 2.0 a while ago but it had some big issues, I've fixed ALL of those issues and the update has been released! Below are steps to install. If you had a hard time playing the original public demo, give this one a shot! It's seriously so much better. (Thanks for all of the criticism on it, it really helped!)

[*] Make sure you own venge

After 2.0 is done, then I start working on [b]Act 2 again[/b]! I'm aiming for December 2025, but that is REALLY an estimate.

Thank you all SOOO much for your support, even 4 years later. This game was/is made entirely by me (and only me) so I really do apologize for the slow pace, but I think 2.0 is really going to be something! Hopefully the demo is a ton of fun too! Now here's some awesome screenshots!

notes.title: Act 0 (2.0) DONE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you all for your continued support of my silly little horror game, I've got some exciting news to share!

[b]Act 0 [i](2.0)[/i] has been COMPLETED![/b]
If you didn't know, I'm remaking the entire game from scratch in an effort to up the quality and make the game better in every way! See a video about that here:
[previewyoutube=qSP7JlMBdWA;full][/previewyoutube]

Act 0 is half of that 2.0 project, and it has now been completed! (Some more polishing is needed!)

[previewyoutube=nMLc6dWAbqk;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's the breakdown:
[list]
[*] [b]Intro cutscene:[/b] This cutscene has been completely remade from scratch and now tells the story better, is more visually appealing, and just overall higher quality! The music has also been replaced with my own song, "Crying Bubblegum". If you have already played the game and are looking to replay it, you will also be able to easily skip this cutscene from the pause menu (really not recommended but yall forced me into it :( )

notes.title: Update 1.1.4! - TONS OF FIXES
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I've spent all day today fixing a ton of stuff, check it out!

[h3]Big Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed ALL volume issues in the game. No more loud jumpscares, no more buggy skeletons, its all fixed!
[*] Fixed the settings (visual mostly) not saving between scene files or on reload (yes, this means motion blur will STAY off)

I'm expecting Act 2 to be about 2-3 hours long, so there will be plenty of fun and spooks coming your way!

[b]Act 0 (2.0)[/b] is going very well! I've finished all of the music for it and I've been working on the act itself. It feels soo much more polished and refined. This has been fixed! I am sooo sorry to anyone who had this bug, you can now finally enjoy the game! :)

The Act 0-2 soundtrack will be released on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, etc a few days early, you'll be able to listen to it and make predictions about the game and stuff. It'll be fun!

[b]Act 0 (2.0)[/b] - You'll see massive improvements all over, the game will run smoother, the house will look and feel more realistic, you'll be able to explore more rooms inside the house and a lot more around the neighborhood. There will be a new phone sequence and bike ride as well. The act will stay structurally the same, but will just be 100x better. This is a 100% free update!

notes.title: VENGE RELEASE and the Future
notes.content:
Thank you so much for all of your support! The game is doing well! The release went pretty smoothly, but it isn't perfect. Over the next few weeks, I'll be putting out 3 patches. 

- The first will fix a bunch of the major issues, for example, settings not saving or respawning not working properly. I will only fix things that interfere with gameplay.

- The next fix will work on optimization. I am hoping to get the game 25% faster on most people's computers. 

- The last fix will work on some minor fixes and new additions. 

After that, I'll begin working on a special update. Regarding development, these Acts take some time to make. I want to be super open about where I am at and what I want to add, but secretive. I think I found a way to do that.

Some plans I have for the future:
       - 100% randomized offices
       - Better randomized rooms
       - Global Leaderboards for the minigames
       - Better Learning for AI and the game itself
       - WAY better optimization

That's all I'll share for now :)
Please report any bugs using the bug icon on the title screen, you can give more detailed feedback in the Coaster Games Discord server, ([url=https://discord.gg/bHn9VTa]Discord Link[/url]), I love feedback and I want to make this game the best it can be!

Thank you so much!
